content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rochester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project management experience. Review PMI's documented prerequisites—typically a high school diploma plus substantial project-leadership hours, or a bachelor's degree plus fewer hours. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify your qualifications before you commit.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led format meets PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the full PMBOK Guide framework. Classes run on a schedule that fits working professionals in Rochester—no travel required, 100% online.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your official PMP application to PMI, including proof of your 35 contact hours. Pay the applicable exam fee directly to PMI. Our team provides detailed guidance on the application portal and required documentation to avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides aligned to the current PMP blueprint. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before test day so you sit with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to PMI's 3-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or project delivery. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and webinars to support your credential maintenance and career growth.
